ValidationRule.description: Prevents the unlinking of tasks if the value isn't 0.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF(AND( ISBLANK( pse__Assignment__c ) = True ,ISCHANGED(pse__Assignment__c) ,pse__Estimated_Hours__c <> 0 ) , true , false )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please set the task estimated hours to 0 before removing resourcing link.
